service.description: A validated 850 as one sales order of the connection's product store, for its partner: the ship-to from the partner's location code (EdiLocation), each line's product from its IDs through the profile's crosswalk, its quantity, unit (EdctUom) and price as sent, requested dates (DTM 001, 002, 010, 037, 038), SAC charges and allowances (EdctCharge, stated amounts) and notes, then placed; approving it is the seller's decision. The same purchase order again is a Duplicate and its identity with changed content a Conflict, neither making an order. Refusals: UNSUPPORTED_SEGMENT, CURRENCY_MISMATCH, SHIP_TO_REQUIRED, SHIP_TO_UNKNOWN, ITEM_UNKNOWN, ITEM_MISMATCH, LINE_DUPLICATE, SAC_UNSUPPORTED, CONFIG_INVALID.

The 855 body for an order's decision: BAK (AD, AC or RD) and each purchase order line with its ACK (IA, IQ, IP, IC or IR) and the quantity the order now has. Refuses an order not decided (ORDER_NOT_DECIDED), with lines the purchase order did not have (LINE_ADDED_UNSUPPORTED) or more than one part (MULTIPLE_PARTS).
